name: Poison (Cost: 1d6)
entries: You add a toxin to your strike, forcing the target to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.
To use this effect, you must have a {@item Poisoner's Kit|XPHB} on your person.
